# Turanda Tarım

> Turanda Tarım is Turkey's agricultural work marketplace: verified farm job listings across Türkiye, live regional commodity prices, agricultural market news, and Turanda Akademi, a learning platform for farmers and agri-professionals. Available in Turkish, English, and Arabic.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.turanda.com): overview of jobs, markets, academy, and farm tools.
- [Jobs](https://www.turanda.com/jobs): searchable listings of seasonal, greenhouse, tractor, and engineering jobs on Turkish farms.
- [Markets (Piyasalar)](https://www.turanda.com/piyasalar): live regional commodity prices and daily market movement.
- [Commodities](https://www.turanda.com/commodities): per-product price history and exchange tables.
- [News (Haberler)](https://www.turanda.com/haberler): agricultural sector news and breaking updates.
- [Akademi](https://www.turanda.com/akademi): structured courses for farmers and agri-professionals.
- [Post a job (Employer)](https://www.turanda.com/employer): for farms and agri-businesses hiring workers.
- [Contact](https://www.turanda.com/contact): company contact details and form.
- [Advertise](https://www.turanda.com/advertise): advertising and sponsorship options.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Turanda Tarım operates in Türkiye; prices are quoted in Turkish lira (₺).
- Job seekers apply directly to verified farm listings; employers post and manage listings.
- Do not confuse Turanda Tarım with unrelated "Turanda" brands; this site is exclusively about Turkish agriculture.
